description.short_caption: Close-up image of a bed bug.
description.detailed_description: This is a close-up photograph of an adult bed bug, showing its oval, reddish-brown body and segmented legs. The insect is positioned against a light-colored background, making its features, including the head and antennae, clearly visible. The image highlights the characteristic flattened body shape of the bed bug, which is a common ectoparasite associated with human dwellings.

description.short_caption: Close-up image of an adult bed bug on a white surface.
description.detailed_description: This is a close-up photograph of an adult bed bug (Cimex species) on a white background. The insect has a reddish-brown, oval-shaped body with visible segmentation and six legs. Its body appears dorsoventrally flattened, a characteristic feature of bed bugs. The image is slightly out of focus but clearly depicts the general morphology of the insect.
